set.body:
ModelFormula.render -> Vector[FormulaToken(text, kind, termIndex, argPath, status)] where status marks accepted vs proposed grammar; parser keeps source positions; JSON codec for ModelFormula, HrfSpec, ContrastSpec and ModelBuildSpec (ledger G5).
Acceptance: parse(render(spec)) == spec for the five example studies; printed text is accepted by the parser; error positions point at the offending argument.

Consumer: PLS Neuro native model studio epic (see the PLS Neuro integration ticket that names this id). General capability; no application-specific branches.
PLS Neuro spec: docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md and docs/design/model-studio/ (branch studio/model-authoring-hillclimb, f8d32f0).
set.title: Canonical formula printer with span tokens, AST source positions and a JSON codec for the typed model spec
